name: Together
description: Residents of a sheltered accommodation  block run by a warden go about their business.

videos.title: Episode #1.1
videos.overview: New residents move in and get to know one another at Rutherford Court.

videos.title: Episode #1.2
videos.overview: The residents are concerned about the maintenance of the electrics and someone calls the RSPCA concerning Mr. Harding's dog.

videos.title: Episode #1.3
videos.overview: Richard is worried that Duggie knows that he jumped the queue for his flat. Mr. Harding has trouble cooking.

videos.title: Episode #1.4
videos.overview: Harry Klein is not happy his wife  Dora takes a cleaning job at Rutherford Court. Divorcee Mr. Sheperd joins the residancy.

videos.title: Episode #1.5
videos.overview: The residents pools coupon comes through but someone forgot to post it.

videos.title: Episode #1.6
videos.overview: The residents argue about what they should spend their winnings on.

videos.title: Episode #1.7
videos.overview: Shepherds wife's affair with a footballer is reported in the paper and the new freezer is installed in the laundry room. Duggie's pliers go missing along with other items.

videos.title: Episode #1.8
videos.overview: Julie tells Richard she's pregnant, Mrs. Potts falls of a Stepladder leading to the discovery of missing items in her room.

videos.title: Episode #1.9
videos.overview: A red serviette finds its way into a communal white wash and Julie discusses her pregnancy with Daphne.

videos.title: Episode #1.10
videos.overview: Mr. Shepherd brings a lady friend home from the office. Derek announces he is leaving and asks Daphne a favour.

videos.title: Episode #1.11
videos.overview: Martha falls unwell and some residents start to become bored of their daily routine. Julie starts to suspect Richard is having an affair.

videos.title: Episode #1.12
videos.overview: Daphne finds taking care of Martha challenging and the lounge needs a new TV. Julie confronts Richard about his working late.

videos.title: Episode #1.13
videos.overview: The 'influenza' illness is becoming an epidemic after Lynne falls ill causing concern that the illness is something more. Mike gets confronted about the fish he stored in the communal freezer.

videos.title: Episode #1.14
videos.overview: Duggie has to pay for all the  spoilt freezer foods and some of the residents have a darts match with a local pub team.

videos.title: Episode #1.15
videos.overview: Julie and Richard throw a dinner party and news spreads about Trevor's sexuality.

videos.title: Episode #1.16
videos.overview: The Dunn's are concerned about having to finding a new home, half the residents have hangovers and Duggie's homophobia continues.

videos.title: Episode #1.17
videos.overview: Richard is upset Julie is working for Swanson and Dora wins a prize.

videos.title: Episode #1.18
videos.overview: Mike asks Tricia out on a date much to Duggies annoyance.

videos.title: Episode #1.19
videos.overview: The residents hold a meeting decide whether trevor's boyfriend should be aloud to move in with him.

videos.title: Episode #1.20
videos.overview: The Dunn's have found a new flat and Mike takes Elsie out for a motorcycle ride. Harry starts a petition after losing a vote to allow Trevor's boyfriend to stay. Julie is admitted to hospital.

videos.title: Episode #1.21
videos.overview: Julie is released from hospital following her miscarriage and her mother arrives to help and Daphne is contacted by an old friend.

videos.title: Episode #1.22
videos.overview: Dr. Fuller moves in.

videos.title: Episode #1.23
videos.overview: Tricia need consoling after breaking up with Mike.

videos.title: Episode #1.24
videos.overview: Leslie is told he is too old for a new job and the price for a cup of tea goes up.

videos.title: Episode #1.25
videos.overview: Daphne returns from looking after her Aunt, Duggie has an accident painting Elsie's flat and Harry finds a stowaway in his cab.

videos.title: Episode #1.26
videos.overview: The Dunn's prepare to move out.

videos.title: Episode #1.27
videos.overview: The Dunn's have their send off and Harry thinks about stopping driving his cab.

videos.title: Episode #2.1
videos.overview: New tenants arrive and exercise classes are introduced.

videos.title: Episode #2.2
videos.overview: Duggie gets caught doing some decorating for one of the tenants.

videos.title: Episode #2.3
videos.overview: Fripp wants to make an allotment, the Powell's alarm goes off and Dr. Edwards misses Daphne.

videos.title: Episode #2.4
videos.overview: The residents don't like the idea of turning the garden into an allotment.

videos.title: Episode #2.5
videos.overview: Peter and Trevor return from their holiday to the disapproval of Arthur. Duggie tries to organise some relief for Lynne and himself.

videos.title: Episode #2.6
videos.overview: Trevor wants to open a bar after returning from Greece and a resident causes a flood.

videos.title: Episode #2.7
videos.overview: Residents have mixed feelings about Susi's keep fit class and people are worried about a new council car park taking over their land.

videos.title: Episode #2.8
videos.overview: Lily and Joe argue over both petitioning against the council.

videos.title: Episode #2.9
videos.overview: Duggie reveals he i brewing in the boiler room, Geoff's wife pays a visit to Susi's ire and residents are concerned when Mary is injured.

videos.title: Episode #2.11
videos.overview: Susi collects Geoff's son from school much to his wife's ire and Trevor rejects Charlene's advances.

videos.title: Episode #2.12
videos.overview: The heating in the block stops working.

videos.title: Episode #2.13
videos.overview: Duggie's absence affects the running of the building, there's a flu outbreak and Joe finds a part-time job.

videos.title: Episode #2.14
videos.overview: Lily has her bag snatched and is injured and Duggie is suspected of having an affair with Sarah.

videos.title: Episode #2.15
videos.overview: A community volunteer arrives to help Lily, Geoff and Susi contemplate telling  Lynne they are not married and Arthur continues to complain about his blood pressure.

videos.title: Episode #2.16
videos.overview: Charlene gets an offer to sing, Arthur has a hospital appointment and Trevor and Peter talk about their relationship.

videos.title: Episode #2.17
videos.overview: Duggie has trouble changing a fuse, the Powells worry about getting evicted and the Suttons have dinner guests.

videos.title: Episode #2.18
videos.overview: Prue impresses Arthur, Peter and Trevor have more tension between them and Tony's character is realised.

videos.title: Episode #2.19
videos.overview: Lynne has the flu, can Duggie cope! Charlene secretly sends her music to a record company and Joe offers Susi advice to Susi.

videos.title: Episode #2.20
videos.overview: Joe hires a car for a date, Sarah is confronted about her drinking and Gill tries to manipulate Geoff.

videos.title: Episode #2.21
videos.overview: Lynne has recovered but Duggie now has the flu, Arthur is fighting to regain fitness following his stroke and Charlene gets a response.

videos.title: Episode #2.22
videos.overview: Charlene confides in Russell in an attempt to overturn Lynne not allowing her to go to London, Martha Is asked to move to a smaller flat and Arthur comes up with a novel way to teach Mary to drive.

videos.title: Episode #2.23
videos.overview: Nobody has heard from Charlene since she left for London and Geoff receives a letter from his son.

videos.title: Episode #2.24
videos.overview: Geoff is torn between his ex wife and Susi and Charlene's mother comes looking for her.

videos.title: Episode #2.25
videos.overview: Charlene returns, Lily is getting cold feet, Martha may move out and Geoff and Susi part ways.
